display.purpose: Page/app titles, greeting headline, SOS hero headline, stat-card counts. Inter 800.

label.purpose: Stat labels, table headers, chip/tab text, tier badges. Inter 600-700, often uppercase, tabular-nums for figures.

shadows.name: shadow-sm
shadows.purpose: Resting state for cards, chips, pills, list containers.

shadows.name: shadow-md
shadows.purpose: Floating/elevated elements: map legends, overlays, hover state on role cards.

shadows.name: shadow-lg
shadows.purpose: Reserved for the most prominent floating elements.

shadows.name: sos-glow
shadows.purpose: Accent-tinted shadow under the SOS hero button, reading as physically raised.

shadows.name: phone-chassis-ambient
shadows.purpose: Ambient drop shadow on the citizen phone-mockup chassis.

motion.name: sos-ping
motion.purpose: Pulsing ring on the SOS button/FAB while actively broadcasting — the one pulsing control in the system.

components.name: SOS Button
components.description: Large circular primary SOS action on the citizen Home screen; pulses while actively broadcasting.
components.css: .ds-sos-btn { width: 148px; height: 148px; border-radius: 50%; background: #C23A22; border: none; color: #fff; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; gap: 6px; cursor: pointer; box-shadow: 0 16px 32px rgba(194,58,34,0.35); transition: transform 0.15s; } .ds-sos-btn:active { transform: scale(0.96); } .ds-sos-text { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 16px; font-weight: 800; letter-spacing: 0.02em; } .ds-sos-btn.ds-active { animation: ds-sos-ping 1.6s ease-out infinite; } @keyframes ds-sos-ping { 0% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(232,69,44,0.45); } 70% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 16px rgba(232,69,44,0); } 100% { box-shadow: 0 0 0 0 rgba(232,69,44,0); } }

components.name: Role Card
components.description: Landing page's Citizen / LGU entry cards; soft-shadowed, lifts on hover.
components.html: CCitizenReport your status and get help.→
components.css: .ds-role-card { display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 16px; background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 24px; padding: 20px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(20,33,61,0.06); text-decoration: none; color: inherit; transition: box-shadow 0.15s ease, transform 0.15s ease; } .ds-role-card:hover, .ds-role-card:focus-visible { box-shadow: 0 10px 28px rgba(20,33,61,0.10); transform: translateY(-2px); } .ds-role-glyph { width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 50%; background: #FDEAE6; color: #C23A22; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; font-size: 20px; font-weight: 700; flex-shrink: 0; } .ds-role-title { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 15.5px; font-weight: 800; color: #16203D; display: block; } .ds-role-desc { font-size: 13px; line-height: 1.5; color: #545F70; display: block; margin-top: 4px; } .ds-role-arrow { color: #8891A0; font-size: 15px; transition: transform 0.15s ease, color 0.15s ease; } .ds-role-card:hover .ds-role-arrow { transform: translateX(4px); color: #E8452C; }

components.name: Status Chip
components.description: Safe/Trapped/Injured status selector chip; solid signal-color fill when active.
components.css: .ds-chip { padding: 12px 18px; border-radius: 999px; border: 1.5px solid #E6E9F1; background: #EEF1F6; color: #545F70; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; cursor: pointer; transition: 0.15s; } .ds-chip-active-injured { background: #C23A22; color: #fff; border-color: #C23A22; }

components.name: Stat Card
components.description: LGU dashboard top-strip summary count card (Critical/High/Cleared).
components.css: .ds-stat-card { background: #FFFFFF; border-radius: 16px; box-shadow: 0 2px 8px rgba(20,33,61,0.06); padding: 12px 18px; min-width: 92px; text-align: center; } .ds-stat-count { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 24px; font-weight: 800; line-height: 1; color: #C23A22; } .ds-stat-label { font-size: 11.5px; color: #545F70; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.02em; text-transform: uppercase; margin-top: 5px; }

components.name: Tier Badge
components.description: Critical/High/Low priority badge in the LGU report table.
components.css: .ds-tier-badge { display: inline-block; padding: 3px 10px; border-radius: 999px; font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11.5px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; background: #FDEAE6; color: #C23A22; }

components.name: Bottom Tab Bar Item
components.description: Citizen app's primary navigation item (5-item bottom bar); active item turns accent red.
components.css: .ds-tab-item { flex: 1; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 3px; background: none; border: none; color: #545F70; cursor: pointer; padding: 4px 2px; } .ds-tab-item span { font-family: 'Inter', sans-serif; font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 0.01em; } .ds-tab-active { color: #E8452C; }

narrative.overview:
AHON's interface is a standard, trustworthy mobile-safety-app and admin-dashboard look — white soft-shadowed cards on a light grey ground, a single red accent, Inter throughout — not a chart-instrument metaphor. This replaces the prior "Typhoon Track Chart" world (near-black/cream chart-paper registers, graticule grids, dashed-instrument markers, Overpass/Overpass Mono type, near-universal 4px radius) in full, across all three surfaces: the landing page, the citizen app, and the LGU command center. The direction was user-pinned from two reference screenshots (a panic-button SOS app and a driving-safety dashboard app) — a "canon/standing-exit" choice explicitly favoring a UI a stressed citizen already knows how to use on sight, overriding that session's dice-rolled world set.

The system carries forward two pieces of prior-brand continuity deliberately, not as drift: the AHON critical-red accent, and the color roles of the 7-state mesh legend (SOS, civilian, rescuer, senior/PWD, volunteer, offline, self). Both are re-rendered in the new visual language — solid filled circles with white borders instead of dashed-ring instrument markers — but the meanings are unchanged from the system this replaces.
keyCharacteristics: Soft-shadowed white cards on a light cool-grey ground (#F4F6FA) — elevation is now load-bearing, a full reversal of the prior "flat instrument, no shadow" rule.
One accent, one meaning: AHON red (#E8452C, solid fill #C23A22) spent only on SOS/critical/primary-emergency, never decoration — carried over from the prior brand for continuity, not reinvented.
Inter for everything, including tabular-nums on every live-updating figure — the prior system's monospace (Overpass Mono) identity is fully retired.
A generous, soft corner scale (10-24px, full circles/pills for buttons, avatars, badges, markers) replacing the prior near-universal 4px radius.
Bottom tab bar (citizen app) / left sidebar (LGU dashboard) as primary navigation, replacing the prior left spine-tab book and sliding drawer.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: AHON red is spent only on SOS/critical/primary-emergency meaning, on every surface. It is not available for decorative accents, non-critical highlights, or "because it's the brand color" uses — a rule preserved unchanged from the prior chart-instrument system into Clean Care.

rules.name: The Legend Continuity Rule
rules.body: The 7-state mesh node legend (SOS, civilian, rescuer, senior/PWD, volunteer, offline, self) keeps the exact color role it had before the redesign. Only the rendering changed — solid filled circles with white borders replacing dashed-ring chart markers — never the color-to-meaning mapping.

rules.name: The Tabular Readout Rule
rules.body: Any numeral that updates live (stat counts, timestamps, hop-adjacent figures) is set with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums via the shared .tabular utility so digits don't shift the layout as they tick — preserved as a functional rule from the prior system, no longer tied to a monospace face.

rules.name: The Load-Bearing Shadow Rule
rules.body: Every card and floating control casts a soft, non-offset shadow at rest; flat, borderless surfaces are not part of this system's vocabulary except for hairline-divided list rows within a card.

dos: Do spend AHON red on SOS/critical/primary-emergency meaning only, on every surface.
Do keep the 7-state mesh legend's color-to-meaning mapping unchanged even as its rendering evolves.
Do set every live-updating number in Inter with tabular numerals via the .tabular utility.
Do give every card and floating control a soft, non-offset shadow at rest — this system has no flat-card mode.
Do give every LGU report a deep-linkable URL hash reference (#N04) that reopens straight to that case.
Do draw icons from Font Awesome Solid at one consistent weight; never substitute a unicode symbol or emoji.
donts: Don't reintroduce the prior system's graticule grid, dashed-instrument marker style, or Overpass/Overpass Mono type — that instrument identity is fully retired, not a fallback to preserve.
Don't give a rectangular button or card a hard, offset (non-blurred) shadow; this is not a neobrutalist world — shadows stay soft and ambient.
Don't put the LGU priority list or AI Triage panel back into a drawer that slides over the map; they are permanently docked beside it in this world.
Don't add an eighth accent hue without the same justification the seven-state legend required for Volunteer Violet.
